title: Defy Gravity
description: Learn about the bizarre properties of superfluids in this short video

scenes.narration: Imagine a liquid that can flow uphill and never stop moving
This is possible with superfluids, which exhibit zero viscosity
At extremely low temperatures, certain liquids enter a quantum state
In this state, they can climb up walls and even defy gravity
The implications of superfluids are still being explored by scientists
But one thing is certain, they will change our understanding of the physical world forever
